item.title: Squeak 2.34.2
item.description:
The new layout gets its own composer.

  • In the new layout (Settings › General), the composer is one field with its tools on the left, a chip above it naming the duck and model ("Pip · Opus 5.5"), and a round send button.
  • A message's time, Copy and more actions show when you point at it or tab to it, instead of under every message. Code blocks keep their Copy button.

Also in 2.34.1

Tabs stay put; the Room reads like a room.

  • Each pond keeps exactly the tabs you opened, in your order, across restarts. A new pond opens on its Dashboard with no tabs, and Squeak never adds tabs by itself. Closing a duck's tab no longer puts it off duty.
  • "Delete Duck…" in a duck's menu removes it for good. Off duty and Bring back are there too.
  • Ducks have short names, and lines between ducks say who they went to.
  • A duck's run of status lines folds into one row; tap "+N earlier" to see the rest. Off duty ducks are listed in their own group in the roster.
  • The @ and / suggestion lists open above the composer instead of running off the bottom.
  • Ducks stay on duty when Squeak restarts; they go off duty only after an idle hour.
  • When a duck shows you a file, it opens in the app and the Artifacts list updates.
  • A duckling shows the model it really runs on, the same in its timeline row and in the helper strip.
  • Try the new layout in Settings › General (off by default): a row of your ducks instead of tabs, the Pond panel beside the Room, and each duck's Changes, Files, Canvas and Terminal in a pane beside its chat.

Also in 2.34.0

The Room works for you.

  • Say "make it a task" in a pond's Room and Squeak gives it to the best duck: one already on related work, or a new duck. It starts at once; turn on "Ask before starting" in Pond settings if you'd rather tap Go.
  • Ducks post one short line when they take a task, get stuck, hand off or finish. Tap a line to read more. Bigger tasks get a plan card you can comment on.
  • @mention a duck to give it work directly. Ducks hand work to each other the same way, in the Room where you can see it.
  • Each pond has a shared Notebook of lessons its ducks have learned, readable and editable in Pond settings.
  • Ducks go off duty after an idle hour and come back when related work arrives. Pond settings set how many ducks work at once (4 by default).
  • In folder ponds, two ducks can't edit the same file at once; they sort it out in the Room.
  • "Make it a Git Pond…" in a pond's ⋯ menu puts a folder pond on GitHub (private by default). "Invite someone…" is there too.
  • Members of a shared pond can follow the Room and post in it; their tasks wait for your approval unless you give them Collaborator.
  • Tidier window: the layout picker moved to Window › Workspace, duplicate buttons are gone, tabs drop before or after by half, ⌃⇧← and ⌃⇧→ move a tab, and canvas Fit eases instead of jumping.
